## About
Sniffnsnooz (Sniff & Snooz) is Delhi NCR's premier 360-degree pet care ecosystem. The company provides doorstep mobile van pet grooming, luxury store salon grooming, home-visit veterinary care, pet companion consultation (healthy puppies & kittens), comprehensive pet health insurance, personalized in-home pet sitting, daily dog walking, and 24/7 monitored pet boarding. Operating across Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Ghaziabad, Faridabad, and Greater Noida, Sniff & Snooz delivers stress-free, professional pet care using 100% organic, pet-safe products and certified groomers and veterinarians.
